svg.title: An evaluation workflow with separate roles
svg.desc: Train-only cross-validation chooses hyperparameters. Refit on training, choose policy on validation, freeze, then assess final test once.

g.text: Fit preprocessing anew inside each fold. Average validation-fold scores.
2. Refit the chosen setting on training rows
3. Choose an action threshold on validation rows
4. Freeze model and policy; assess the final test once
Illustrative classification design (lecture 02). Other tasks use different splits; preserve temporal and group structure.
